scope: PDF Tools end to end in a hidden OctoSense desktop shell built from this branch (debug, macOS, Apple silicon) with the real pdf engine in the app's own storage, plus App Hub's card-host without host services. Every engine call in the shell runs was real.
build_base: 4b704d6b (main with #419, #433 and #432); the branch was then rebased onto c6fbae6f, a docs-only delta that the shell binary does not contain

shell.runtime: the root's .sources: makepad 32d6415f with runtime-patches tree 80242e50, Octoscript-Makepad 33dea2f1, Octoscript 2e37d9e6
shell.launch: a Terminal.app tab (osascript) under the machine's shell-run lock: OCTOSENSE_HOME=<fresh home> OCTOS_APP_CORE_DIR=<home>/octos-home/.octos MAKEPAD_HOME=<home>/makepad MAKEPAD_HIDE_WINDOWS=1 MAKEPAD_REMOTE=127.0.0.1:8915 MAKEPAD_WM_TEST_APP=pdftools; ended with /quit
shell.admitted: card: os.pdftools running under 3 capability(ies), 1 host(s), 67108864 bytes of storage, 4000000000 instructions, 134217728 bytes of heap

card_host.admitted: card-host: os.pdftools 0.1.0 admitted — capabilities {"files", "pdf", "storage"}, hosts {}, storage 67108864 bytes, agent none

commands: frames: sips -c <window> --cropOffset <window> <grab> then sips --resampleWidth <half> (the app's window from each grab's sidecar area)

runs.shell: the samples, light then dark through the shell's style menu (OctoSense · Dark)
runs.restart: the same home again, with Imported PDF.pdf (pdftools_fixture --import-sample) placed in the library between the runs
runs.full: a fresh home whose storage was filled to 8 KB short of 64 MiB
runs.empty: a fresh home with no PDFs, light then dark
runs.missing: card-host, the samples, MAKEPAD_WIDGET_STYLE=macos; no host services

checks: The library lists the samples with the engine's first pages and '4 pages  ·  9 KB'; 'PDFs up to 64 MB' from files.status
Open a PDF from this device: files.import is refused with 'foreground_required: Return to this app before choosing or sharing a file' (a hidden window never has focus) and the app shows it in a card
Field guide opens on its page grid (five columns from on_app_resize); a page opens at 1400 px; Next goes to page 3
Text shows 'PAGE 1'; finding 'wren' reports '2 pages contain “wren”.'
Info shows 'A4, 210 × 297 mm', 'Not protected' and 'Helvetica, Helvetica-Bold, Times-Italic, Times-Roman'

Split every 2 previews 'Makes 4 files'; Where I choose marks 'File 2 starts here'; light splits at page 2 (2 files, Pages 2–7); dark splits every 2 pages (4 files, Page 7) and first says 'Replaces 1 file of the same name in your library.'
A damaged file can't join a merge ('“Damaged scan” can't be opened, so it can't be merged.')
Merge Quarterly report and Board minutes, Board minutes moved up, into 'Merged' (6 pages · 13 KB); dark merges Apartment lease and Board minutes into 'Merged 2'; both open
Remove asks once more and removes the PDF ('Removed “Field guide-part1” from PDF Tools.')
Damaged scan reads 'Couldn't open this PDF' with the engine's own message
After a restart Merged and Merged 2 are still there; Imported PDF is read (3 pages), drawn, opened, and its text and page show
With 8 KB left, the library says 'PDF Tools' storage is full' and a merge fails with 'There isn't room for it in PDF Tools' storage…'; removing a PDF leaves 4 PDFs
The empty library offers Open a PDF from this device, in light and dark, and shows the refusal
In card-host: 'This device has no PDF engine' with 'no service answers "pdf" on this device', and Open a PDF from this device 'Not available here'
No [E], on_render, callback or script-budget error lines in any shell or card-host log
not_verified: the host's file dialog and what follows a real import (imported() in the script): a hidden window cannot open the dialog
the import's other refusals (storage full, too large, too many files, busy)
window sizes other than the shell's default; a light/dark switch re-runs the script, so the grid keeps two columns until the window's size changes
